name: Fractera Storage
shortDescription: The object storage of the node: pictures, videos and documents of every element with a stable address for each file, thumbnails, blurred placeholders, video trimming and site icon sets.
longDescription: The object storage of the node, split from the data layer in step 550. Elements upload files through /media/upload (up to 200 MB) and get a permanent address; for a picture the element keeps its size and a tiny blurred copy for a placeholder. It measures and trims videos on the server (ffmpeg), makes thumbnails and builds a full icon set of a site from one image. Consumers keep calling /media on the database element of the node, which passes the request here as it is; the address of a stored file stays on the database element.
accepts: The node data key (X-Data-Secret) or a privileged session; multipart uploads, JSON bodies.
returns: JSON records of files and icon sets; the files themselves.
